why: Ace Pilot's plane circles 6 studs from its tower at 0.8 rad/s × Speed Multiplier; bombs hit what is within Explosion Range of the plane
Pursuit drives at its Speed ÷ 5 studs/s along the path, within Patrol Range of the patrol point (default: the path point nearest the tower)
Accelerator: Charge Up, then its beam ticks until it has dealt Overcharge damage, then Cooldown; read from the columns, the order is assumed

Medic: assigned to the Max Targets most expensive towers in range; Firerate Buff always, Damage Buff only during Ubercharge; one shield per tower absorbs a stun, recharging after Shield Recharge Speed; heals the base by Healing at each wave end up to Overheal Limit above the maximum; over-heal above what the players keep (Over-Heal skill) fades 1/s
Trapper lays a trap every Firerate seconds on a random path point in range; a trap goes off when an enemy steps on it and breaks after dealing its Health in damage
Engineer builds one sentry every Build Range seconds (read as a build time) beside the path within half its range
Crook Boss keeps one bodyguard (two from Level 3) standing on the path next to it, replaced 10 s after it falls
Elf Camp sends its best elf every unit Spawnrate (15 s when the unit page has none), at most 3 + level at once
when a tower's units have no level on their pages, the unit list is spread evenly over the tower's levels

Necromancer: souls = the health of enemies that die in its range; a full Soul Meter builds a grave (Build Time) or levels the lowest; Raise the Dead: Gravestone Spawn Count skeletons per grave with 30×level health and 5×level damage

Hacker: Synapses = targets per attack; Slowness on hit; Wire Fraud = extra cash share when an enemy it hit dies; holograms deal Hologram EV of the damage, last Hologram Lifetime and cost Clone Cost % of the tower's total cost

Drop the Beat (numbers not on the page): Purple 3 pulses of 3-stud knockback and 10% + 2% per tower slowness for 3 s; Green $50 × level + $25 per tower; Red 3 pulses of 30 × level damage and 5 + towers defense loss

Missile: 4× damage in 4 studs; Bee Swarm Grenade: 5-stud radius, 5 sting stacks; Thorns: 5-stud patch for 10 s, Harvester damage every 0.5 s, 25% slow (Farms half); Heatwave: 3× damage, 4-stud knockback; Ice Turret: 20 s, 20% chill, freeze every 5th shot; Bounty: 50% of the enemy's cash up to $5000; SWAT Van explodes for half its health; Jester bombs: fire burn, ice 20% slow, poison, 1 s confusion

Warden crits every third hit; Boomerang's extra boomerangs hit the target and up to two neighbours; Sledger's aftershock deals half damage when the page has none; knockback = force × 0.1 studs; bosses are not knocked back
Mecha Base missiles and War Machine rocket volleys hit 4 studs around the target on their cooldowns; Military Base vehicles fire their cannon at the nearest visible ground enemy within their range
Bandages heals the base at the end of each wave
enemy phases with "stops moving for a few seconds" pause it 3 s; random enemies on death come from the enemies that spawn it, else any non-boss of the mode
